description.en: Rural housing assistance for eligible houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, with beneficiary identification and verification through the programme's survey and Gram Sabha process.

benefit_summary.en: The programme supports construction of a pucca house with basic amenities. Unit assistance depends on the area classification and can converge with sanitation, wage-employment, electricity, drinking-water, and LPG programmes under current rules.

eligibility_summary.en: The official self-check considers rural residence, housing condition, room count, household assets, KCC limit, government employment, registered enterprise, monthly income, taxes, and landholding. Passing a self-check is not a sanction; survey inclusion and Gram Sabha or government verification still apply.

instruction.en: Complete the current official PMAY-G eligibility self-check or Awaas+ survey where it is open.
Contact the Gram Panchayat or block rural-development office to confirm survey-list and verification status.
If selected and sanctioned, follow the construction-stage and account-verification instructions in AwaasSoft or the authorised local process.
